## 中文

- 新增"隐藏词条"差异：数据补丁改到数据库词条之外的建筑字段（如 `solid`、`destroyBullet.damage`）时，也会显示 `原值 -> 新值`；没有变化时不显示。
- 设置中新增"显示隐藏词条差异"开关，可单独关闭该小节，不影响常规词条差异。
- 无法稳定转成文本的整对象/容器替换显示为"已变更"；补齐"新增"分组标题的六语言翻译。

## English

- Added hidden-entry diffs: block fields outside the database stats (such as `solid` or `destroyBullet.damage`) now show `old -> new`, and nothing is shown when they did not change.
- Added a "Show hidden field changes" setting so the section can be turned off independently without affecting regular stat diffs.
- Whole-object/container replacements without a stable text form show a single "changed" marker, and the "Added" group header is now localized in all six languages.
